_comment: Arm definitions for bench/ratchet.py. Adding a lever is a change to this file,
not to code. Every arm inherits `common` and then applies its own `args`.
`throughput_control` is what speedups are attributed against (no speculation).
`quality_control`   is what the McNemar gate compares candidates against.
They are the same arm here: attribution and losslessness both reference the

smoke._why: Wiring check, not a measurement. Proves boot/probe/suite/teardown works before committing hours of GPU time to a real arm. Numbers from it are meaningless: 1 repeat, 1 cell.
smoke._max_tokens: 200, not 32. At 32 this model emits NO content deltas at all -- the qwen3 reasoning parser is still inside an unclosed <think> when the budget runs out, so bench_fixed sees zero content chunks and every cell errors. A smoke test small enough to be fast can be too small to be valid.

baseline-nospec.desc: No speculative decoding. The attribution and losslessness reference.

mtp3.desc: MTP K3. The recommended config; ~2x decode, lossless on GSM8K n=200.

mtp3-ssmfp16.desc: MTP K3 + fp16 SSM state. +18.6% KV pool; quality only 'no detectable harm' at n=200.

mtp3-prefixcache.desc: UNTRIED lever from README 'Worth stealing'. Prefix caching was never enabled here.

mtp3-chunkedprefill2048.desc: UNTRIED lever. SGLang reports 8192-token chunks stall decode ~600ms on hybrid GDN.
